page: Microsoft Azure NC40ads_H100_v5 is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for compute-intensive workloads. It features 40 dedicated physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 9V84 processor operating at 3.7 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 320.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core, and is bundled with a single NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPU containing 94 GB of VRAM. For local storage, the instance is equipped with 3971 GB of local disk capacity and supports Premium Storage.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong multi-core and single-core CPU capabilities. The Geekbench multi-core test places the instance in the top tier with a score of 23376.0, while the single-core score of 2140.0 falls in the top 25 percent. Memory performance is highly polarized; the cached read-only small block memory bandwidth reaches 5952.26 GB/sec, whereas the uncached large block read and write bandwidths of 182.31 GB/sec and 91.33 GB/sec represent average tier performance. Large-scale data operations are supported by a Passmark database score of 30606.81 and a Redis SET throughput of 100.89 million operations per second.

For machine learning workloads, the integrated NVIDIA H100 GPU delivers text generation speeds of 286.08 tokens per second for a small 135M LLM and 33.22 tokens per second for a medium 7B LLM, both ranking in the top 25 percent. However, performance drops to an average tier of 3.88 tokens per second for a large 70B model. Given these hardware and benchmark characteristics, this server is suited for GPU-accelerated computing, large-scale database operations, and medium-sized language model inference.
